meta.prompt_source: 用户提供的英语二大作文图表题：某高校学生每月参加志愿服务次数占比（从未参加 35%；1-2 次 45%；3 次及以上 20%）

band.rationale: 对照第三档描述定档：本文'基本完成了试题规定的任务'，包含图表全部三个数据点并给出原因与评论，'应用的语法结构和词汇能满足任务的需求'，但存在较多基础性错误（activities is、does not provides、percentage 误用、逗号粘连），属'有一些语法结构或词汇方面的错误，但不影响理解'；衔接为 Firstly/Secondly/In my opinion 等'简单的衔接手法'，'内容基本连贯，层次基本清晰'，未达第四档'语言基本准确，只有个别错误'。字数 135 为建议下限 150 的 90%（预检 soft_ok），按锚点 3 属小幅不足不机械罚分，仅作提示。

dimensions.name: 切题与图表解读
dimensions.evidence: 35 percentage of students never join in volunteer activities, while 45 percentage of them take part in one to two times every month. Only 20 percentage students join three times or more.
dimensions.deduction_reason: 三个数据点及类别全覆盖，评论部分（原因+建议）切题，任务两项要求均完成；但评论停留在断言层面，未点明数据反映的核心趋势（多数学生参与频率偏低），且数据表达存在系统性词汇失误（percent/percentage）。

dimensions.name: 内容展开与评论
dimensions.evidence: Firstly, some students think study is more important than volunteer work, so they spend all their time in the library. Secondly, the school does not provides enough information about volunteer activities, many students don't know how to join.
dimensions.deduction_reason: 两条原因均为一句断言加简单结果，无进一步解释或例证；建议部分（offer more chances / balance）笼统，未展开论证。

dimensions.name: 组织与段落逻辑
dimensions.evidence: In my opinion, volunteer activities is good for students. It can help us learn skill and make friend. The school should offer more chances and students should balance the the study and volunteer work. Only in this way can we grow up better.
dimensions.deduction_reason: 三段式（描述—原因—评论）结构完整清晰（预检：3 段，47/45/43 词），Firstly/Secondly/In my opinion/Only in this way 衔接标记使用得当，倒装收尾是亮点；但第二段仅两句、论证深度不足，故微扣 0.5。

dimensions.name: 语法与句式控制
dimensions.evidence: the school does not provides enough information about volunteer activities, many students don't know how to join；volunteer activities is good for students；It can help us learn skill and make friend
dimensions.deduction_reason: 主谓一致（activities is / does not provides）、逗号粘连（两个独立分句以逗号连接）、指代与单复数（It 指 activities、learn skill and make friend）、相邻重复词 the the（预检标记），错误几乎每段都有但均不阻碍理解，按第三档描述扣 1 分。

dimensions.name: 词汇与搭配
dimensions.evidence: 35 percentage of students never join in volunteer activities；There are many reasons for this phenomonon
dimensions.deduction_reason: percent/percentage 误用贯穿全部三处数据句（35/45/20），属图表作文核心词汇系统性失守，而非偶发；另有 phenomonon 拼写错误。整体用词偏简单但尚能达意，故重扣至 0.5。

dimensions.name: 格式与卷面
dimensions.evidence: The chart shows the situation of students taking part in volunteer activities in a university.
dimensions.deduction_reason: 三段分段清晰、长度均衡（47/45/43 词，预检数据），首句规范入题，无格式或卷面问题，不扣分。

consistency.adjustments: 初评按语法 1、词汇 1 试算，维度和为 10，超出所定第三档区间（7–9）；鉴于 percent/percentage 误用在全部三处数据句中系统性重复出现、属图表描述核心词汇失守，将词汇与搭配调整为 0.5，维度和收敛为 9，落入 7–9 区间，校验通过。

sentence_edits.original: The chart shows the situation of students taking part in volunteer activities in a university.
sentence_edits.issue: 命中中式直译速查表："the situation of ... taking part in"（……参加……的情况）语法成立但属中式直译，图表首句宜直接交代图表内容（参加频率的分布）。
sentence_edits.revised: The chart shows how often students in a university take part in volunteer activities every month.

sentence_edits.original: 35 percentage of students never join in volunteer activities, while 45 percentage of them take part in one to two times every month.
sentence_edits.issue: percentage 误用：与具体数字连用应用 percent（35 percent of the students），percentage 为不可数名词不与数字搭配；该误用贯穿全文三处数据句。
sentence_edits.revised: 35 percent of the students never take part in volunteer activities, while 45 percent of them take part once or twice every month.

sentence_edits.original: Only 20 percentage students join three times or more.
sentence_edits.issue: 同句两处问题：percentage 误用且缺 of，应为 20 percent of the students；join 作不及物用法在此语境缺宾语，用 take part / participate 更妥。
sentence_edits.revised: Only 20 percent of the students take part three times or more.

sentence_edits.original: There are many reasons for this phenomonon.
sentence_edits.issue: phenomonon 拼写错误，应为 phenomenon。
sentence_edits.revised: There are many reasons for this phenomenon.

sentence_edits.original: Secondly, the school does not provides enough information about volunteer activities, many students don't know how to join.
sentence_edits.issue: does not 后应用动词原形 provide 而非三单形式；两个独立分句仅用逗号连接构成逗号粘连，应加 so 或改用分号。
sentence_edits.revised: Secondly, the school does not provide enough information about volunteer activities, so many students do not know how to join in.

sentence_edits.original: In my opinion, volunteer activities is good for students.
sentence_edits.issue: 主谓一致错误：activities 为复数，谓语应用 are。
sentence_edits.revised: In my opinion, volunteer activities are good for students.

sentence_edits.original: It can help us learn skill and make friend.
sentence_edits.issue: 可数名词需用复数：learn skills、make friends；且 It 指代前文复数主语 activities，应用 They。
sentence_edits.revised: They can help us learn skills and make friends.

sentence_edits.original: The school should offer more chances and students should balance the the study and volunteer work.
sentence_edits.issue: the the 为相邻重复词（预检已标记）；balance 后的 the 多余，应为 balance study and volunteer work。
sentence_edits.revised: The school should offer more chances, and students should balance study and volunteer work.

sentence_edits.original: Only in this way can we grow up better.
sentence_edits.issue: 命中中式直译速查表：grow up better（更好地成长）为中式直译，按表定级 awkward；句首 Only in this way 引导的倒装结构使用得当，修改时应保留。
sentence_edits.revised: Only in this way can we make greater progress.

improved_version:
The chart shows how often students in a university take part in volunteer activities every month. 35 percent of the students never take part in these activities, while 45 percent of them take part once or twice a month. Only 20 percent take part three times or more.

There are several reasons for this phenomenon. Firstly, some students think that studying is more important than volunteer work, so they spend most of their time in the library. Secondly, the school does not provide enough information about these activities, so many students do not know how to join in.

In my opinion, volunteer activities are good for students. They can help us learn skills, make friends, and gain practical experience. Therefore, the school should offer more chances for students to serve others, and students themselves should balance study and volunteer work. Only in this way can we make greater progress.
top_problems: percent 与 percentage 混用贯穿全部三处数据句（35/45/20 percentage），图表作文最核心的数据表达失守，应固定使用"数词 + percent of + the + 复数名词"结构
基础语法一致性错误密度高且几乎每段都有：主谓一致（activities is / does not provides）、逗号粘连、可数名词单复数（learn skill and make friend）、相邻重复词 the the
评论部分展开单薄：两条原因均为一句断言加简单结果，缺少解释或例证支撑，直接限制内容展开维度得分
practice_advice: 下次练习采用"数据句三查"：写完图表描述后逐句回查是否为"X percent of the students + 谓语"格式，再固定用十分钟为每条原因补写一句支撑（举例或解释），训练"断言之后必有支撑"的展开习惯。

patterns: The chart shows how often ... take part in ...
X percent of the students ..., while Y percent of them ...
There are several reasons for this phenomenon. Firstly, ... Secondly, ...
Only in this way can we ...
